business.description: Modern Threads (India) Limited operates in woollen and yarn divisions, manufacturing woollen products and yarn. The company has a woollen division at Bhilwara and a yarn division at Village Raila, District Bhilwara, Rajasthan.

outlook.statement: Major upgradation & capacity expansion conceived current year & company has plan increase sale of yarn by around 20-25% based on medium & coarse count. Company is expecting from 3rd quarter of the next year, the plant
The Board of Directors of your company has decided to increase Solar power capacity and RO plant which require capital expenditure in coming years

Export future is not very optimistic because of many small customers & country has reduced their wool & blended yarn consumption. Export market is expecting price drop in wool because it has gone up dramatically high this year.

Consistent efforts are being made by the Woollens Division of the Company to ensure sustainable leadership for its products in global market. Woollen Division has also initiated efforts to retain existing customers base and contracting newer customers in overseas market with different product range in worsted yarn so as to achieve improved performance and profitability in the ensuing period.
Your company is expecting improved performance of woollen division as well as yarn division in the coming years.
